By giving their child the name Samid, parents are expressing their hopes and aspirations that their child will grow up to be a person of strength and resilience, able to face life's challenges with determination and fortitude.

The Arabic word ‘Allah' meaning God, is derived from the same root letters as the word ‘samad’, which means eternal and unchanging. By giving their child this name, parents are instilling a sense of connection to the divine, and inspiring their child to strive for spiritual growth and development throughout their life.
